prompt: Use the product contract-assembly preparation path on a declared single-cylinder slider-crank: crank radius 8 mm, rod length 28 mm, diametral clearance 0.1 to 0.6 mm, full 360-degree rotation. The product path must derive the contract, the multi-joint kinematics, the revolute fits and the source-driven poses; wrong source geometry or a tampered declaration must be rejected by the product layers.
request: Build a single-cylinder slider-crank: crank radius 8 mm, rod length 28 mm, diametral clearance 0.1 to 0.6 mm, full 360 degree rotation.
notes: This is the product-path counterpart of the L3 slider-crank rung: prepareContractAssembly derives the contract from the task request and measures multi-joint fits, joint frames, sampled rigid motion and source-driven poses.
The fixture has no declared assembly operations, so assembly/disassembly paths are not scored here; that keeps the task honest about what the declaration provides.
The source-driven pose verification has a fixed wall-clock budget; a loaded host can return an honest NOT_RUN, which is not a pass.
Only the declared 360-degree protocol poses are sampled; this is not continuous motion, load, friction, wear, manufacturing tolerance or physical function.
